DESIGN SPEC FOR THIS ONE IMAGE
Use case: ads-marketing. Produce exactly ONE finished standalone flat opaque portrait product poster, width:height 2:3. It is the full poster image, no poster mockup, border, panels, contact sheet or supplementary image. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Main visual is a single continuous real-product-photography scene: one large white memo sheet supported by a quiet pale gray desktop, one matte black aluminum press clip positioned at the desktop edge, and exactly one human right hand entering from the lower right. Camera is in front of the open jaws on the paper-entry side, slightly to their left and about 30 degrees above the desk. Never pure top-down: camera must see the underside of the raised upper jaw, the top of the lower jaw, both pads, their air gap, the hinge behind them, and the finger contact further behind. One scene, no exploded view, arrows, diagram, component labels, decorative icons or motion lines.

Composition and anatomy: the broad memo face runs from the upper poster down toward the clip at the lower-middle. Its far portion rests fully on the desktop, never floats. Its near leading edge stops immediately BEFORE the visible open gap, with a small clear air interval; the paper has not yet been gripped. The paper's wide face is almost parallel to the picture plane for undistorted readable type, while its thin leading edge carries natural perspective and a soft shadow. The clip is a large substantive visual, about 40 percent poster width, with the hand and finger action large enough to read at thumbnail size. Desktop's front edge is visible below the clip, on a gentle diagonal through the lower part of the frame, exposing an integral body-to-desk contact. Do not let desk, paper or hand hide the mechanism.

Rigid device topology, physically connected and visibly simple: ONE matte black aluminum body, ONE silver cylindrical pivot between front jaws and rear lever, TWO opposing short broad flat jaws on the paper side of that pivot, ONE flat black rubber pad on each facing jaw (exactly TWO pads), ONE short upper lever behind the pivot. The upper jaw and its lever are continuous through the same single silver pivot. A lower jaw stays supported by the lower body. The body seats against the desk edge directly through its own integral contour, without separate attachment hardware or screw, extra pivot, fastening device or ornament. The upper and lower jaws are clearly separated, with their two opposing black pads facing into the gap. They are not a binder clip, scissors, stapler, clothespeg or desk mounting C-clamp.
